mix: c = exposure * sum_i(w_i * linear_i); out = linearToSrgb(pbrNeutral(c)) (+ dither)
tonemap_glsl: vec3 pbrNeutral(vec3 c){const float s=0.76;const float dsat=0.15;float x=min(c.r,min(c.g,c.b));float off=x<0.08?x-6.25*x*x:0.04;c-=off;float p=max(c.r,max(c.g,c.b));if(p<s)return c;const float d=1.0-s;float np=1.0-d*d/(p+d-s);c*=np/p;float g=1.0-1.0/(dsat*(p-np)+1.0);return mix(c,vec3(np),g);}
notes: Passes are additive in linear light: linearise each texel, multiply by its pass scale, then add.
poster / poster_ink are already tonemapped with exactly this mix (default_weights / ink_weights).
Mask: hero 255 = pack, 0 = set (use it to seat the pack in the debossed disc or to dim the set); lineup value = 25 * pack index (1..9, in packs[] order).
packs[].box = [x0, y0, x1, y1] in 0..1 image space, origin top-left.
Hero shots: product = the catalogue id the print and ink describe. Other products of the same format reuse the image; their facts must come from the catalogue, not from the picture.
